description.zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the backup plan. Call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to obtain this ID.

description.zh: 任意字符串，用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
description.en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request.
The end timestamp of the backup query time range, in milliseconds.

description.zh: 页码，大于等于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值为0。
description.en: The page number. The value starts from 0, and the default is 0.

description.zh:
每页的记录数，取值30、50、100。

> 默认每页记录数为30。
description.en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100.

> Default value: 30.

description.zh:
是否显示存储类型，取值如下：

- true
- false

> 默认true。
description.en:
Specifies whether to return the storage class. Valid values:

- true

- false

> Default value: true.
The start timestamp of the backup query time range, in milliseconds.

title.zh: 查看增量备份任务列表
